sloka: तस्मिन् हते राक्षसयोधमुख्ये महाबले संयति देवशत्रौ।क्रुद्धस्त्रिमूर्धा निशिताग्रमुग्रं ववर्ष नीलोरसि बाणवर्षम् ।। ६.७०.२७ ।।
transliteration: tasmin hate rākṣasayodhamukhye mahābale saṁyati devaśatrau।kruddhastrimūrdhā niśitāgramugraṁ vavarṣa nīlorasi bāṇavarṣam ।। 6.70.27 ।।

translations.english: Devanthaka, the foremost of Rakshasa warriors, an enemy of gods, endowed with great strength, having been killed in the conflict, Trisira became angry and rained arrows on Neela's chest.
